findings.title: Hard-coded English " quota" suffix inside otherwise localized analytics strings
findings.evidence: AnalyticsFormatters.swift:46/48 and VendorAnalyticsCardView.swift:105 append a literal English word (raised by Jano, remediation B18)
findings.fix: Move the suffix into a localized format key in en/pt-BR/es
findings.impact: pt-BR/es users see an English word in Analytics
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18

findings.title: A crossing that failed while notification permission was denied stays marked after the user grants permission
findings.evidence: authorizationKnownDenied clears only on a later successful delivery (raised by Nemesis, remediation B18)
findings.fix: Re-check permission (or clear the cached denial) on app activation / next crossing and re-arm the denied crossings
findings.impact: One threshold notification is not re-sent until the window resets or a higher threshold fires
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18

findings.title: Two in-flight crossings for one window failing out of order can restore a lower mark that was never delivered
findings.fix: Restore only marks confirmed delivered (track delivered marks separately from pending)
findings.impact: A threshold may be skipped in a rare double-failure race
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18

findings.title: Call sites format percent by hand as PercentText.whole(x) plus % instead of PercentText.format(x)
findings.evidence: PinnedStatusItemManager.swift:258,261,271, MenuBarLabelView.swift:414, ProviderRowView.swift:436, SparklineView.swift:449, VendorSectionView.swift:597 (raised by Higia, remediation B18)
findings.impact: The percent sign is repeated per site
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18
